why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the human.tech Quest site Go to the human.tech Quest , titled "Explore Human Tech", where your XP total, journeys and achievements are tracked.
2 Step 2 : Start the Passport journey Open the Passport journey , which centres on proving you are a real, unique person without revealing who you are.
3 Step 3 : Complete the Privacy and Wallet journeys Work through the Privacy journey and the Wallet journey , trying each product and sharing your own experience of it.
4 Step 4 : Give honest, specific feedback Write honest, specific feedback on each product; repeated spam flags cost you access to every quest.
5 Step 5 : Finish all three journeys Completing every product journey unlocks the Ecosystem Explorer achievement, which carries +500 XP.
6 Step 6 : Look at the Community journey The Community journey is the Covenant, separate from the three product journeys. The quest site does not say whether it counts toward the XP total.
